notes.title: DirectX 12 test version release
notes.notes:
We've received reports of Vampire Mansion not running after the 1.3.0 update,
This is not happening in our work environment, so we are having trouble resolving it.

We've created a test version that rolls back the DirectX targeting changes that were made in version 1.3.0.

If your game is currently not running, please go to
Game→Properties→Beta→Join Beta, select "dx12 - DX12 Target Version", then update and see if the issue is resolved.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
